name: German Sweet Chocolate Pudding Cake
author: Charlotte Hooper

ingredients.name: (4-serving size) JELL-O Vanilla Instant Pudding and Pie Filling
(4 oz.) BAKER'S GERMAN'S Sweet Chocolate, melted
buttermilk (or 1/2 cup sour cream and 3/4 cup water)

instructions: Combine all ingredients in large mixer bowl. Blend: beat 4 minutes at medium speed. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch layer pans. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly pressed. Cool in pans 15 minutes. Remove and finish cooling on racks. Fill with Coconut Filling Coconut Filling. Combine I cup evaporated milk, 1 cup sugar, 3 egg yolks, slightly beaten, cup butter or margarine and 1 teaspoon vanilla in saucepan. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened, about 12 minutes.
